summary.title: Summary
summary.content: 12th-grade researcher in LLM safety, with work spanning software and design. First-authored FORTRESS (TMLR) and the PATCH dataset (EACL 2026 SRW), built an award-winning RAG system recognized by Taiwan's NSTC, and keynoted SITCON (2025, 2026). Currently the youngest research intern at CyCraft Technology, working on attention-based attack taxonomies. Admitted Rank 1 to NTU CSIE via Special Talent Selection. IELTS 8.5; fluent Mandarin and English.
